name: @starter/shared
//exports: This package has no "type": "module" and tsconfig.base.json sets module: NodeNext, so tsc emits CommonJS into dist/. The map must therefore resolve under "require" as well as "import" — an import-only map made the Next.js client (which resolves as ["node", "require"]) fail with "not exported under the conditions". "default" matches both, which is the honest description of a single CJS build. Keep "types" first: condition order is significant and TypeScript warns when types is not matched first.
